steps.text: Climb the south west ladder of Camelot.
Talk to the Squire on the roof of Camelot.

items.name: Poisoned weapon such as Dragon dagger (p++)

steps.text: Defeat the 8 Knights of the Round Table in the room on top of Camelot. It's recommended to flinch the knights on one of the dummies around the room, and use a poisoned weapon to make the process even easier.

items.name: Poisoned weapon such as Dragon dagger (p++)
